params.description: Return opened, closed, or all issues

params.description: Return issues which were closed by the user with the given ID.

params.name: order_by
params.description: Return issues ordered by `created_at`, `due_date`, `label_priority`, `milestone_due`, `popularity`, `priority`, `relative_position`, `title`, or `updated_at` fields.

params.description: Return issues sorted in `asc` or `desc` order.

params.name: due_date
params.description: Return issues that have no due date (`0`), or whose due date is this week, this month, between two weeks ago and next month, or which are overdue. Accepts: `overdue`, `week`, `month`, `next_month_and_previous_two_weeks`, `0`
